theorems.name: Submission.p08_7d1ff633a4_tp26_normal_level_retraction
theorems.statement: ∀ {G : Type} [Group G] (H : Subgroup G), ∃ a : G → H, (∀ h : H, a (h : G) = h) ∧ (∀ (h : H) (g : G), a ((h : G) * g) = h * a g) ∧ (∀ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal → K ≤ H → ∀ g u : G, u ∈ K → (a g : G)⁻¹ * (a (g * u) : G) ∈ K)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
